g.text: Implementing ADR 0001 (revised 2026-10-26): stage C, a tdd gate in hours, the waves, one cutover of tdd (fork = may run together)
(actions outside the repo; Program.cs frozen for outside PRs)
Stage C Program.cs becomes a composition root (behaviour-neutral)
C-1 defect: board reading ignores other repositories
C0 safety net: golden writes, route-and-auth table,
in-process calls, start-up test, CI job for smoke and parity
C1 classes after app.Run to files
C2 dashboard and connect prompt as embedded resources
C5a AddGateway*, IPlantHooks, InProcess via EndpointDataSource
C7a modules: health, status, metrics, dashboard,
C7b modules: runtime hosts, Copilot, transcripts,
webhook, demo, item and worker admin
C8 policies, statics to DI, architecture test
stabilisation gate: architecture test (C8) green; golden writes unchanged;
1 measured tdd batch, no regression; /ready 200, leader acting, restore ok after each release;
W0 safety and quick wins on v1
W0.0 engine switch per environment, FACTORY_V2_OFF reader
gate: 2-hour tdd window, flow times, no stage slower; golden re-recorded
W1 structure and seams S1 to S3, no behaviour change
W1.6 S3 ingress (can feed a shadow engine)
W1.5 S2 command contracts, recording sink
gate: golden writes identical to the W0-gate baseline (CI)
W2..W8 (the plan's tables are the source for their tasks, parallel groups and gates)
W2 Wolverine host, Balanced, mailbox; tdd in shadow mode (2 h window)
W3 v2 integration commands (2 h shadow window)
W4 ingress, board reconciler (2 h shadow window)
W5 DeliveryTrainSaga (shadow run: 4 h or 3 app releases)
W6 docs plan (v2 Tier 1 job, CI)
W7 feature plan (v2 Tier 1 job, CI)
W9.0..W9.8 QC and the remaining verbs on v2
W9.9 tdd cutover to v2 as a whole: adoption, kill-switch drill
cutover gate: 1 measured batch on v2; 4-hour quiet window
